delta.finding: A deterministic local test mutates NVIDIA_API_KEY after authorization but before use; the candidate repair snapshots the recognized runtime environment once before routing, authorization and transport.

primary_sources.finding: TOCTOU applies when shared state, including memory or variables, can change between check and use.
os.environ is a mutable mapping representing process environment; direct modifications update it.

hypotheses.claim: One provider execution is authorized safely only when credential identity, endpoint, provider, budget epoch and zero-cost attestation are derived from one immutable private snapshot also used by transport.
hypotheses.test: Mutate each vector component independently and jointly in every hook between routing, authorization and opener invocation; serialized request, credential and endpoint must remain bound to the authorized snapshot digest.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any post-authorization shared-state mutation changes the provider-visible authority vector or receipt identity.

hypotheses.claim: Snapshotting only the API key is sufficient.
hypotheses.test: Hold the key fixed while mutating endpoint, provider selector, budget epoch or zero-cost attestation. Any changed authorized effect falsifies the counterhypothesis.

hypotheses.claim: Request-body snapshot and authority-environment snapshot must be joined by one receipt digest; securing either alone leaves a cross-snapshot substitution gap.
hypotheses.falsifier: A mismatched request snapshot and authority snapshot reaches opener or VERIFIED/DONE.
